title: ORIVS / OURO — Integrated Communications Ecosystem
summary: An ongoing case study of one communications system with three connected workstreams. The public narrative, approvals, and media are still pending.

blocks.text:
This case study is unpublished. It will describe the ORIVS / OURO communications ecosystem only after the narrative and supporting material are approved.

The working brief treats three efforts as one system: OURO launch communications, NEXT '26 event branding, and investor communications. No results are included.
